name: io.github.larsbaunwall/unlinked
description: LinkedIn profile and recent changes as one up-to-date answer for your AI assistant (read-only, EEA/Switzerland).

environmentVariables.name: LINKEDIN_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: LinkedIn access token from the OAuth Token Generator. Accepts a bare token or 'Bearer <token>'. Required for EEA/Switzerland members only.

environmentVariables.name: UNLINKED_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: How long fetched LinkedIn data is cached in memory, e.g. 30m, 2h, 1d, or 0 to turn caching off. Defaults to 6h.
